name: Have Another Slice Bakery
summary: Have Another Slice Bakery specializes in grain-free, vegan-friendly, and dairy-free desserts, with all items made from scratch with no box mixes. The bakery has served the Detroit Metropolitan Area for over eight years and operates under the oversight of a certified professional food manager. Custom cakes, cookies, pies, cobblers, and homemade caramel corn are available. Customers are encouraged to call or contact ahead to reserve custom orders.
customCakeProcess: Call to reserve custom cakes, cookies, or pies. Contact via phone (586) 281-5795 or email haveanotherslicebakery@gmail.com.
dietaryNote: Grain-free, vegan-friendly, and dairy-free options confirmed. All items made from scratch.
